lines.1: Upper principal line and chordal right hand
lines.2: Upper inner line when simultaneous with principal
lines.3: Left-hand principal/bass line; crosses onto upper staff for lower-stem intermezzo chords, returns to lower staff
lines.4: Independent lower-staff overlapping bass in P008/016/024/052 and fast figuration against bass in P026/030/034/038

continuous_musical_lines.policy: No global OMR label merge. Context-scoped reassignment per target event. Nonprinted silent intervals represented as forward, not visible rests.

context_scoped_relabels: Every source-to-target bar and event is recorded in corrections/change_ledger.json. Context-scoped reconstruction is required because source labels change roles across bars; no unsafe global mapping applied.
removed_empty_lanes: All source-only empty fragments removed; final four line identities each contain pitched material. Forwards represent unprinted silence.
retained_extra_voices: Voice2 is independent upper inner line; voice4 is simultaneous independent bass or moving run. Voice3 crosses onto staff1 without becoming another musical line. Five physical SEP lanes represent four continuous voices.
